steps.name: A Meal in Kali (1)
steps.objective: Talk to [Io] in 「Gerda」, then defeat [Echo] in 「Echo Spring」 to obtain the <Ice Wings of Bondage>. Then report to [Medea] in 「Kali」.

lines.text: (Io stands absentmindedly, apparently lost in thought.)

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: ...I really don't understand.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Io, what is it you don't understand?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: When I encountered that power of destruction...

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Put aside such unholy thoughts. Even remembering that moment gives me goosebumps.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Can a spirit of water and ice get goosebumps?
(Narin raises an arm and examines it.)

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: My mistake. Of course a spirit cannot. But did you call the adventurer? They're coming...

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: No?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello, Io, Narin.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: What brings you here?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Nothing special. I was looking around Gerda. Snow like this is a rare sight for me. It really makes me want to stay.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Thank you for saying that. I love hearing that people want to stay in Gerda.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What were you discussing?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Nothing much. I remembered when I felt that power of destruction...

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: It's all right. Don't worry. I'm alive now. I need to be all right so I can do other things well too.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: There you go again, Io. You're doing well. Don't worry.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Thank you. You're the only one... You just wanted to hear that, didn't you?

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Of course. Quite right. Still, I was a little hurt. Even with me beside you, you kept seeking out that wretched creature... Hmph.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: I tried to make you two friends, but you both refused. And you couldn't enter Echo Spring. Besides, how was I supposed to know it was an evil spirit?

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: All right, all right.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: I asked Mir to bring ingredients just for you from the elder's mountain. So don't be angry.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: If you've gone that far, I shall gladly accept.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: %s, you were just thinking what a strange human and spirit we are, weren't you?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Startled.)

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Look at you jump... Shynic was right. You're fun to tease. Anyway, good timing.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: You're coming somewhere with me. I need to visit Medea.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What brings you to Kali?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Something came up. I need you there, so let's go together.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You need me?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: I'll explain when we arrive. Predictable as that sounds...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. I'll come.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Before Kali, we need to find something. I can only see the other side of Echo Spring if you're with me.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: And you'll need me there if you don't want to get lost, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see...

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: You're always busy, Io. It's important, so take care.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Thank you, Narin. I'll be back soon.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: See you later, Narin.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Be well, Adventurer.

steps.name: A Meal in Kali (2)
steps.objective: Talk to [Shynic] at the entrance to 「Kali」 (the passage from Adrica). When the conversation ends, go back inside 「Kali」 and report to [Medea].

lines.text: (Medea closes her eyes after gazing absently at Kali's sky. Merimel, sharing tea with her, looks puzzled.)

lines.speaker: 메리멜
lines.text: Medea? What's wrong?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: The barrier I worked so hard to strengthen is becoming less meaningful by the day.

lines.speaker: 메리멜
lines.text: What do you mean?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: A guest is coming. From the distant northern sea...
(Merimel startles at the mention of the northern sea.)

lines.speaker: 메리멜
lines.text: Io! Io! You mean Io is coming?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Ah... Merimel, you're a fan of Io as well as Shynic.

lines.speaker: 메리멜
lines.text: Now I can die without regrets...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: ...Merimel, don't joke like that...

lines.speaker: 메리멜
lines.text: I'm sorry, Medea.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I'll introduce you to Io. Wait here.

lines.speaker: 메리멜
lines.text: Yes, yes! Oh, %s is here too. Hello! The parts you gave me are working well.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You're here too, Merimel. I'm glad they're useful. Hello, Medea.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: %s, you've come as well. Ah, welcome, Io.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Sorry for the sudden visit, Medea. Have you been well? I was disappointed not to see you last time.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: At the time, I...

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: I know. I'll wait.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Then wait a moment. Keep this girl company while I prepare tea. Oh, I have some coffee Atkina gave me. Would you like that?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Yes, that sounds good. Your name is Merimel, right?

lines.speaker: 메리멜
lines.text: H-how do you know my name?!

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Don't be so surprised. Medea has told me a lot. That there's a kind, pretty, talented girl in the village, and she feels sorry for keeping her here...

lines.speaker: 메리멜
lines.text: I never imagined she'd say that about me...

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: I saw you as a baby. You've grown so much. Come to Gerda with Medea sometime. We have a Kali in our village too.

lines.speaker: 메리멜
lines.text: May I really? But there's a Kali there?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (So Io visited here long ago...)

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Yes. Titi... Medea knows him too. Thank you for the coffee.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Merimel, Titi is the child who disappeared long ago, when our village descended to Adrika.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: With no news, we thought he had died. I was so happy to hear he was living in Gerda.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: He's doing well, isn't he?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Of course. Eating well, sleeping well, and looking after the ice.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: All thanks to you, Io.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: No, he's doing well through his own efforts. Oh, right. I brought something for you, Medea.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Blueberries as close as I could find to those from the old Kali village, and delicious fish from the northern sea. You liked these, didn't you?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (For just a moment, Medea looked excited...)

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: And this is... Oh, Merimel, could you give us a moment? Shall we have dinner together later?

lines.speaker: 메리멜
lines.text: I'd love to, Io. Then, Medea, %s, enjoy your conversation. I'll see you later.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: What a good girl. I'll be sure to call you.
(Once Merimel leaves, Io takes the ice wings from the ice box she brought.)

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Medea, I'd like you to look at this and tell me your story.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Before that, %s... There's something I'd like you to do.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Shynic will be here soon. Would you keep her company outside for a little while?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What? Shynic? Me?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: She mustn't see the object Io has brought out...

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I'm counting on you.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: For Medea to say that...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don't know what's happening, but I'll go meet Shynic. How long should I keep her?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I'll come outside when it's time.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. I'll keep her occupied.
(On the path from Adrika to Kali's entrance, a figure approaches at almost the speed of light.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Shynic, you're here.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Sniff, sniff. You smell less now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What? Smell...?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: That smell is fading. I'm glad...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Shynic, about this smell...

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: You know, don't you? ♡ Your goddess must have told you something.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris did tell me, but is that really connected to the smell?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Yes. Like it or not, I can smell death. Agasuras reek of it so strongly I want to hold my nose. But you weren't like that.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then I...

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Perse made me this way while she was staying in the Underworld. It's such a nuisance. When you cross the boundary between life and death as easily as I do, these are the sorts of things you sense.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Sigh….
(Shynic's eyes turn wistful for a moment, then she smiles brightly.)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Don't worry. The smell isn't strong anymore♡ Just remember to wash properly.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Shynic.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Anyway, why are you still blocking my way? I'm here to see Medea. Io's in Kali Village, isn't she?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, but….

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Something's going on, isn't it? Tell me. Otherwise, the two of us might end up going straight to hell♡

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Actually, I'd better ask those two coming this way.
(Just as Shynic says, Io and Medea are approaching from inside Kali Village.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: You're here.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Medea, Io! I'm here. Io, that's lovely, but don't hug me. It's too hot.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Aw, what a shame.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: %s, thank you for doing this, even though it was a lot to ask.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, it was no trouble.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Shynic, I asked %s to keep you occupied for a little while.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: That's fine, that's fine. I'm sure you had something to do, Medea. Just know that I'll be visiting often in return♡

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Sigh….

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: …What was it that made you keep me out?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: A trap Weiss set to make you lose control, Shynic. You have to pass through Deborah to reach Avalon.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: When the appointed day comes, you'll lose control the moment you arrive in Deborah.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Weiss mixed the power of Binding and the witch's power into a wicked spirit's wings, then cast them onto the other side.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: So I asked %s to find them and Medea to purify them. Being on the other side weakened the Binding, but only Medea can neutralize the witch's power.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The witch's power….

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I'm all right.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: If you'd arrived in Kali before the purification was finished….

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: …So that's why you asked me to look after Shynic.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Thank you. And I'm sorry….

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: You went to all this trouble because of me….

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: No, it's all right. We were going to do it anyway.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: That's it. I'm sending those scoundrels straight to hell, and I'll go with them♡

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Let's do it together. I'm bound for hell anyway.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (They talk about these things so casually….)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I'll wait for you♡

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: I'll wait too, Medea.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I know very well that there isn't much time left. There are still things I must do….
(Medea pricks up her ears as she speaks.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: It seems the meal is ready. Thanks to the ingredients Io brought, we have quite a feast. Please follow me.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Is it all right for me to come in?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Would you return to Tartaros if it weren't?

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Nope♡ I'm staying to have some fun!

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: You're good at handling Shynic, Medea….

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: What an absurd thing to say…. %s, please join us for a meal. There is also something I'd like to discuss with you privately.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right….

steps.name: A Meal in Kali (3)
steps.objective: Talk to Medea in 「Kali」, then turn in the quest to [Noel] in 「Underground City Tartaros」.

lines.text: (The blue wooden dining table is laden with Kali dishes and food made from ingredients brought from Gerda. The meal begins when Shynic picks up a plate.)
(As the special meal for the long-awaited guests draws to a close, Medea sends Merimel on her way and quietly addresses %s.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: There is something I must tell you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Go ahead, Medea.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I'd like you to visit the area near a place that may be your next destination.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: My next destination?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: If you go there and sense its energy, it will help me with my work….

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: We may be able to hinder the one who sent you that message telling you to wait for the night.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How did you know about that?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: She told me as well…. The night she has waited so long for….

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Daphne….

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: …She may eventually have an adverse influence on the goddess as well….

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then where should I go?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I don't know the exact place, but I know whom you should visit.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Meet with members of the Kali tribe and follow where fate leads you. At the end, you may find your answer….

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: If anyone notices you searching for that answer, tell them about me. You may tell them everything you know.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you sure that's all right?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. Then I should go see Noel and Titi. Medea, why are you looking at me like that?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: …Something about you has changed since we last met.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, has it?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I believe it's the goddess's influence. You have certainly grown stronger….
(Medea's smile deepens more than usual.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: You needn't worry about how much we trust you. The Kali tribe has faith in you….

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Medea. I'll visit Noel as soon as I can.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Yes, please do…. Give Titi my regards along the way. Tell her I'm well….

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I heard everything♡ What can I do?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Stay put.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: How can you ask me to stay in such a boring state♡

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I wasn't expecting you to listen anyway….

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: It's strange. There's no way I wouldn't notice if a witch appeared. She's been stirring up trouble with Weiss everywhere, yet I've never had a proper look at her.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: She can conceal her presence. She has even appeared in my form….

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: I'll teach that rabbit witch a lesson.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The rabbit witch?)

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: %s, let's go to Tartaros.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I should go see Noel.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: Just ask Noel if everything is all right, then go see the next member of the Kali tribe. Understood?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I will. Oh, what about you, Io?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Me? Hmm… maybe I'll stay in Kali a few more days. Um, Medea? Don't look like that. I'm only joking.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: I'm going to Dragon Valley to see Atkina.

lines.speaker: 샤이닉
lines.text: All right, Io. I'll visit again, Medea. What a shame I have to leave without even getting a taste of your barrier this time.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I'll prepare a stronger barrier so you won't have cause to say that again. Oh dear, she's already gone….

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: She's always so entertaining. Hehe.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh? Shynic? Weren't we going together? You can't just run off ahead of me….

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: She said, "Let's go," but she never said "together."

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sigh, I suppose there's nothing I can do. Goodbye, then. I'd better get going too.
(After the two leave, Io and Medea clear the table. When their eyes meet, Io quietly speaks.)

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Medea.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Yes, Io?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: What will you do with Weiss when that day comes?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Whatever you all wish….

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: I'm asking what you want, Medea.
